$description: YoRHa design tokens (unofficial fan project). Theme-independent set: typography, spacing, radius, border, shadow, motion, z-index.

sans.$description: Default UI stack, Korean first. OFL fonts only.

sans-ja.$description: Applied under :lang(ja) for Japanese glyph forms.

mono.$description: Fixed width: Decipher, BootLog, Kbd, numerals.

tight.$description: Consumer utility only (headings in app code). Components use the type pair.

snug.$description: Consumer utility only. Components use the type pair.

body-cjk.$description: Body line height, Korean / Japanese (28px; 30px comfortable). --yorha-leading-body points here under :lang(ko), :lang(ja).

latin.$description: Body line height, Latin text (26px; 28px comfortable). --yorha-leading-body points here under :lang(en) and for unmarked text.

xs.$description: Line height paired with 12px type (whole px).

sm.$description: Line height paired with 14px type (whole px).

lg.$description: Line height paired with 18px type (whole px).

xl.$description: Line height paired with 22px type (whole px).

2xl.$description: Line height paired with 28px type (whole px).

3xl.$description: Line height paired with 36px type (whole px).

display.$description: Line height paired with 48px type (whole px).

measure.$description: Maximum line length of running prose (about 40 Korean characters).

paragraph-gap.$description: Space between paragraphs in running prose.

base.$description: Tailwind --spacing multiplier (4px). Fixed: density changes the size tokens, not the grid.

grid.$description: Cell size of the decorative background grid (8px, two pixel-grid steps).

sm.$description: Small control height (toolbar item, tab, chip, calendar cell). 24 / 32 / 40px by density.

md.$description: Default control height (button, input, select trigger, toggle). 32 / 40 / 48px by density.

row.$description: Row height of menu, option, list and table rows (min). 28 / 32 / 40px by density.

md.$description: Inline padding of md controls and inputs.

indicator.$description: Fixed box of a checkbox, radio, switch thumb track indicator. Density-fixed.

bullet.$description: Fixed box of a list bullet or status dot. Density-fixed.

menu-rule.$description: Thin rules above and below the selected menu row. Set to 0 to turn off.

text.$description: Hard offset text shadow for uppercase headings.

panel.$description: Panel / dialog enter (equals modal: one "surface arrives" time).

stagger.$description: Delay per row in staggered lists (30-80ms). Last row starts at stagger * stagger-max.

stagger-enter.$description: Entry duration of one staggered row or tile (yorha-stagger, MenuList). stagger * stagger-max + this stays within 500ms.

loop.$description: One cycle of a looping indicator (spinner, indeterminate progress, skeleton, button busy). Reduced: slower, opacity only. Off: 0 (indicators render static).

popover.$description: Popover, tooltip, menu and select popup, enter (yorha-pop).

collapse.$description: Height change of accordion and collapsible panels (yorha-collapse).

tab-indicator.$description: Active tab indicator travelling between tabs.

route-exit.$description: Route transition, leaving view (faster than enter).

shared-element.$description: Shared element morph between two routes (view-transition-name).

press.$description: Press feedback on buttons and other pressable controls (yorha-press).

modal.$description: Modal dialog and alert dialog popup enter (yorha-unfold: clip unfolds from a centred line).

modal-backdrop.$description: Dialog and alert dialog backdrop fade, enter.

modal-backdrop-exit.$description: Dialog and alert dialog backdrop fade, exit.

modal-fade.$description: Dialog popup opacity fade-in (yorha-unfold), linear; 120ms linear when reduced.

modal-content.$description: Dialog content rises 4px and fades in (yorha-unfold).

modal-content-delay.$description: Delay before the dialog content starts (yorha-unfold).

drawer-exit.$description: Drawer exit, scaled by the swipe strength.

glitch.$description: RGB channel-split burst on one line of display text (yorha-glitch). The channel offset and slice decay smoothly. One burst.

flicker.$description: One smooth opacity pulse 1 -> 0.35 -> 1 on a non-text mark (yorha-flicker).

stream.$description: One data row arriving (yorha-stream): opacity and a 4px translate, staggered.

caret.$description: Block caret blink period (yorha-caret). Blinks 6 cycles, then solid.

standard.$description: Default easing for wipes and panels.

out.$description: Entrance and exit curve: strong ease-out. Dialog, popups, panels, route, toggles.

move.$description: Movement of an element already on screen (ease-in-out).

in.$description: Not used for UI exits (ease-in starts slow and reads as lag); exits use the default easing, faster. Kept for authors who need it.

emphasized.$description: Large surfaces that travel far: drawer, route, shared element, collapse, tab indicator.

decelerate.$description: Small popups entering from their anchor (yorha-pop).

step-reveal.$description: Deprecated alias (v4 motion-smooth): motion is smooth, there are no stepped easings. Kept for one release; use ease-yorha-out.

step-scan.$description: Deprecated alias (v4 motion-smooth): motion is smooth, there are no stepped easings. Kept for one release; use ease-yorha-out.

step-loop.$description: Deprecated alias (v4 motion-smooth): motion is smooth, there are no stepped easings. Kept for one release; use ease-yorha-out.

step-flip.$description: Deprecated alias (v4 motion-smooth): motion is smooth, there are no stepped easings. Kept for one release; use ease-yorha-out.

reduced-fade.$description: Opacity fade that replaces spatial motion when data-motion=reduced (120ms there, 0 in full and off). Use max(<duration token>, this) for opacity.

spatial.$description: 1 while scale / translate / height movement is allowed, 0 when data-motion is reduced or off. Multiply distances by it.

pop.$description: Scale a popup starts from and ends at (yorha-pop).

shift.$description: Offset a panel or a staggered row starts from (yorha-panel, yorha-stagger).

stagger-max.$description: Highest row index that still adds stagger delay; later rows enter together (yorha-stagger).

fx-mask-25.$description: Dither mask level 25 for the dissolve keyframes; none when reduced or off (the dissolve becomes a plain fade).

fx-mask-50.$description: Dither mask level 50 for the dissolve keyframes; none when reduced or off (the dissolve becomes a plain fade).

fx-mask-75.$description: Dither mask level 75 for the dissolve keyframes; none when reduced or off (the dissolve becomes a plain fade).

decor.$description: Grid, vignette, ornaments: behind content. Host: relative isolate.

state.$description: Interaction state strengths in percent (colour-mix of ink; disabled mixes fg). High-contrast overrides them.

pressed.$description: Pressed tint strength for grouped items, rows and cells (bg-yorha-pressed).

range.$description: Range fill strength between calendar range ends (bg-yorha-range).

disabled.$description: Disabled content strength, mixed from fg (text-yorha-disabled).
